Implement risk assessment and mitigation strategies to ensure service continuity and infrastructure security. Familiarity with orchestration tools, monitoring systems, and infrastructure automation. ITIL certification or equivalent experience with service management frameworks. Experience with service delivery financials, including OPEX/CAPEX, budgeting, and P&L management. If you are a skilled maritime professional ready to contribute to an essential industry, this is your opportunity to make a real impact. At Svitzer, every role matters. Our team members play a vital part in keeping ports moving and ensuring global trade flows smoothly. If you are passionate about the maritime industry, thrive on teamwork, and meet our criteria, we’d love to hear from you. Why Join Us? Industry Leadership: Work with a global leader in towage and marine services, committed to safety, quality, and operational excellence. You’ll be part of a company with over 180 years of maritime expertise. Career Growth: We offer an exciting environment where professionals can develop their skills and advance their careers. Whether you are looking to gain more experience or take on new responsibilities, we support your growth. Diversity and Inclusion: We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, fostering an environment of respect, collaboration, and innovation. At Svitzer, we believe that diversity strengthens our teams. Safety Culture: Safety isn’t just a priority at Svitzer—it’s our way of working. From comprehensive training to state-of-the-art equipment, we ensure a secure and supportive environment for all employees. What You’ll Be Doing As an ASD Tug Boat Master , you will take command of the tug and lead the crew to ensure safe and efficient operations, including: Managing the tugboat operations and ensuring compliance with safety standards. Supervising and coordinating crew activities, including scheduling and readiness. Ensuring compliance with Svitzer policies, statutory obligations, and safety management systems. Maintaining operational and safety reports. Providing leadership, mentorship, and training for crew members. Participating in safety training and operational improvement initiatives. What You’ll Bring We’re looking for a dedicated and safety-conscious professional who meets the following criteria: 1st Class Master Certificate of Competency (Moroccan nationality required). Minimum required experience operating ASD tugs in port towage operations. Fluency in Arabic, French, and English (mandatory). Ability to lead a team effectively and maintain a collaborative, safety-focused environment. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to perform under pressure. Familiarity with industry technology and basic MS Office skills. The candidate must reside within 1 hour of Tanger Med II Port to ensure timely availability for operations.
